scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build:win: npm run asset:icon && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:win:dir: npm run asset:icon && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.benchmark: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/benchmark_runner.py --clips-manifest benchmark/clips/manifest.json --prompt-suite benchmark/prompts/live_answer_set.json --runs 3 --warmup-runs 1
scripts.stt:prewarm: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/prewarm_stt_models.py --models small.en medium.en large-v3 --device auto
scripts.benchmark:sweep: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/model_sweep.py --manifest artifacts/bench_clips/manifest.json --prompt-suite benchmark/prompts/live_answer_set.json --runs 3 --warmup-runs 1 --stt-device auto --target-stt-ms 800 --target-first-token-ms 900 --target-assist-final-ms 2500
scripts.corpus:sync: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/sync_web_corpus.py --config configs/web_corpus_sources.yaml --output artifacts/corpus/web_corpus.jsonl --json
scripts.corpus:sync:quality: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/sync_web_corpus.py --config configs/web_corpus_sources.yaml --output artifacts/corpus/web_corpus.jsonl --max-docs 1800 --max-per-category 180 --max-per-domain 32 --min-quality 0.35 --dedupe-jaccard 0.86 --min-text-chars 1400 --extractor-mode auto --category-weighted-quota --json
scripts.glossary:build: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/build_glossary_lexicon.py --input artifacts/corpus/web_corpus.jsonl --output artifacts/corpus/glossary.jsonl --json
scripts.finetune:dataset: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/build_finetune_dataset.py --input-dir artifacts/session_exports --session-candidates-jsonl artifacts/curation/session_candidates.accepted.jsonl --corpus-jsonl artifacts/corpus/web_corpus.jsonl --external-qa-jsonl artifacts/corpus/external_interview_qa.jsonl --glossary-jsonl artifacts/corpus/glossary.jsonl --output artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.jsonl --report artifacts/finetune/interview_dataset_report.v2.json --translate-en-missing
scripts.finetune:sample-dpo: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_venv_python.ps1 scripts/sample_sft_completions_for_dpo.py --input-jsonl artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.jsonl --base-url http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 --model llama3.1:8b-instruct-q4_K_M --limit 120 --output artifacts/curation/sft_completion_samples.jsonl
scripts.finetune:export-bundle: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/export_train_bundle.py --dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.jsonl --valid-dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.valid.jsonl --quality-report artifacts/finetune/interview_quality_report.v2.json --judge-config configs/judge_config.json --output-dir artifacts/train_bundle
scripts.finetune:import-artifacts: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/import_train_artifacts.py --input-dir artifacts/train_bundle/results --target-dir artifacts/finetune/imported
scripts.finetune:hf:prepare: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/train_hf_sft.py --dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.jsonl --valid-dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.valid.jsonl --out-dir artifacts/finetune/hf_qwen3b --attempts-path artifacts/finetune/training_attempts.hf_qwen3b.json --profile qwen3b_sft_local --quality-report artifacts/finetune/interview_quality_report.v2.json --require-quality-pass
scripts.finetune:hf:validate: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/train_hf_sft.py --dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.jsonl --valid-dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.valid.jsonl --out-dir artifacts/finetune/hf_qwen3b --attempts-path artifacts/finetune/training_attempts.hf_qwen3b.json --profile qwen3b_sft_local --quality-report artifacts/finetune/interview_quality_report.v2.json --require-quality-pass
scripts.finetune:hf:smoke: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/train_hf_sft.py --dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.jsonl --valid-dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.valid.jsonl --out-dir artifacts/finetune/hf_qwen3b --attempts-path artifacts/finetune/training_attempts.hf_qwen3b.json --profile qwen3b_sft_local --quality-report artifacts/finetune/interview_quality_report.v2.json --require-quality-pass --run-smoke
scripts.finetune:hf:full: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/train_hf_sft.py --dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.jsonl --valid-dataset artifacts/finetune/interview_train.sft.v2.valid.jsonl --out-dir artifacts/finetune/hf_qwen3b --attempts-path artifacts/finetune/training_attempts.hf_qwen3b.json --profile qwen3b_sft_local --quality-report artifacts/finetune/interview_quality_report.v2.json --require-quality-pass --run-full
scripts.finetune:hf:package-ollama: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run_train_python.ps1 scripts/package_lora_for_ollama.py --base qwen2.5:3b-instruct-q4_K_M --adapter-dir artifacts/finetune/hf_qwen3b/full --model-name interview-copilot-hf-qwen3b
